name: B10-0246/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the old challenges and new commercial practices in the internal market
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to fix the EU's single market — the system that lets goods, services, money and people move freely between member countries. It wants fewer administrative burdens, especially for small businesses, better enforcement of existing rules, and stronger protection for consumers shopping online. It also wants action on shrinking product sizes at the same price, unfair pricing between countries, unsafe imports from outside the EU, and misleading environmental claims. This is an opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to act in upcoming strategies and laws.
- **Who it affects:** Businesses, shoppers, customs and market inspectors across the EU.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is due to present a new single market strategy in June 2025.
